notes.title: Demo released!
notes.notes:
Demo now released!

From now on you can taste selected levels of The Naked Game, including original gameplay experience.

The demo includes two environmental puzzles from the beginning of the story.


Check it out and have fun !

Your SiCzech Arts Team


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31274816/ad0144d34133abf1fc97eff12b0c5fa3b831df6e.png[/img]

notes.title: HOTFIX 1 (v2.thenakedgame)
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
looks like we've made a hotfix for you.
[list]
[*] we added inverted y mouse axis

[*] we added czech localization (interface and subtitles)

[*] we added an option called [i] "the last notes"[/i]  which allows you to finish with reading of the last notes in the game if you didn't manage it at the end

[*] we fixed several small bugs
[/list] 
Thank you for your support !
